form.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF. After choosing a picture you can crop it to a square; GIFs become still images.

crop.title: Crop picture
crop.instructions: Drag the picture or use the arrow keys to position it, and zoom with the slider or the + and − keys. The circle shows how the avatar will appear.
crop.sourceTooLarge: This file is too large to edit in the browser (at most 25 MB).
crop.decodeFailed: This image could not be opened. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF file.
crop.exportFailed: The cropped picture could not be created. Try again or choose another image.

rejection.tooLarge: A profile picture can be at most {maxMegabytes} MB.
rejection.unsupportedType: Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images can be uploaded.
rejection.invalidDimensions: Image edges must be between {min} and {max} pixels.
rejection.uploadRefused: The upload was refused. Check your permissions or try again in a few minutes (at most 10 images per 10 minutes).
